summary_en: JG44 acquired 3,864,488 shares (including warrants) in HYUGA PRIMARY CARE through a tender offer that ended November 10, 2026, securing 52.03% voting rights and becoming parent company and largest shareholder on November 17, 2026. Founder CEO Tetsuji Kurogi ceased to be a major shareholder.
title_en: Notice regarding results of tender offer for shares and stock acquisition rights of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. by JG44 Corporation and changes in parent company, largest shareholder, and major shareholders
translation_en_brief:
JG44 Corporation completed a tender offer for ordinary shares and warrant certificates of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. (7133, Growth Market) on November 10, 2026. The offer period ran from September 28, 2026, and received 3,864,488 shares and warrants (converted to share equivalent). This exceeded the minimum threshold of 1,518,400 shares required for the tender to succeed. The acquisition resulted in full completion of the tender terms.

Settlement of the tender offer commenced on November 17, 2026. Following settlement, JG44 holds 38,644 voting units representing 52.03% of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE's total voting rights, calculated against an adjusted share base of 7,427,072 shares (including 295,200 shares from exercisable warrants and net of treasury shares). This voting stake makes JG44 the parent company and largest shareholder of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE. JGIA 3-Gou Investment Business Limited Liability Partnership, the parent entity of JG44, also becomes an indirect parent company through its 100% ownership of JG44.

As a result of the completed tender offer, Tetsuji Kurogi, founder and representative director (CEO) of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE, ceases to be a major shareholder or largest shareholder effective November 17, 2026. The company previously announced no prior capital relationship, personnel connections, or transaction relationships between JG44 and HYUGA PRIMARY CARE prior to the tender offer.
